g.text: STEP 1/4 — who is this stick for?
🛠️ IT Tech — Repair, rescue, and reinstall anything. Windows + Linux recovery in…
🎯 Pentester — Offensive tooling, wordlists, and persistent Kali for engagements…
🔍 DFIR Analyst — Imaging, triage, memory forensics, and evidence handling.
🕶️ Privacy User — Daily privacy, compartmentalisation, and safe browsing.
🧰 General Mix — The everything stick — best of all worlds when size allows.
Personae ship curated sets of ISOs + tools per tier. You can tune the plan next.
